notes.model_choice: Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507: open weights on Hugging Face, released 2025-08 (before 2026-01-01), 4.0B parameters (<= 32B), non-thinking instruct model; ~8 GB in bfloat16, so it runs on a Colab T4 or a 16 GB Apple-silicon Mac.
notes.device_dtype: auto: cuda (bfloat16 if supported, else float16) > mps (bfloat16) > cpu (float32).
notes.max_context_tokens: Prompt budget; if exceeded, the lowest-ranked chunks are dropped first.

hybrid.score_normalization: min-max over all chunks, per query and per retriever

evaluation.primary_metric: exact: normalized reference answer is a whole-token substring of a retrieved chunk
evaluation.answer_normalization: NFKD, accents stripped, lowercase, non-alphanumerics to spaces, whitespace collapsed
evaluation.soft_metric: token recall: share of the answer's non-stopword tokens found in one retrieved chunk
evaluation.significance_test: exact McNemar test on per-question hit@5 (exact)

frozen.status: Frozen after the final (targeted) corpus patch on 2026-10-25; no further retrieval tuning on the public dev set.

primary.label: dev-tuned: alpha chosen among 0.25/0.5/0.75 on public_evaluation_data.json, so its dev numbers are optimistic

frozen.generation_top_k_rationale: Top-5 is the default: top-10 adds ~0.03 retrieval hit rate but doubles the prompt (~2.6k -> ~5k tokens) and the number of distractors; it stays top-5 unless the end-to-end top-10 run shows a real gain (see outputs/results/rag_top_k.csv).
